specs: src/server/app/sets/plant-products/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/confirmation.e2e.spec.js — (1) deep-linking /plant-products/notifications/{id}/confirmation on an UNSUBMITTED notification redirects back to the hub URL (needs only a started notification); (2) after driving the full stub-mode journey to submit (reuse the journey-completion + declaration-submit helper the pp-039 declaration spec established — extend it rather than duplicating; live-animals confirmation.e2e.spec.js:28-38 is the shape), the page renders: exactly one H1 and it is the govuk-panel title 'Import notification sent', the GBN-PP reference visible in the panel body, all four summary-list rows (notification reference, customs-declaration reference, customs document code 'C085', inspection status 'Not required'), the warning text, all three h2 guidance sections with their body copy, both exits visible, no back link, no form controls, no button named 'Copy'; (3) 'Return to your dashboard' link navigates to '/plant-products' — the PLANT dashboard under this set's own mount; assert the prefixed URL, never a bare '/', which under R7 is the server-wide 302 to /live-animals and would prove the link had dropped its set prefix; (4) axe: AxeBuilder({ page }).withTags(['wcag2a','wcag2aa']) on the rendered confirmation, zero serious/critical violations (single state — a terminal page with no inputs has no error state; also assert h1 count === 1 explicitly since page-has-heading-one is a best-practice rule axe's wcag tags do not run — the exact escape hatch that let IPAFFS ship this page with no H1).
acceptanceCriteria: GET /plant-products/notifications/{ref}/confirmation on a SUBMITTED notification returns 200 and renders a govuk-panel whose govuk-panel__title is the page's ONLY H1, reading 'Import notification sent' — the IPAFFS missing-H1 defect (page spec nonStandardPatterns[0], c-014 family) is fixed, and the <title> matches the visible heading.
The panel body renders the submitted notification's minted reference (GBN-PP-YY-XXXXXX format).

A govuk-summary-list renders four rows: the notification reference; 'Reference for your customs declaration' (pass 1: the notification reference — no separate customs scheme exists for GBN-PP refs, recorded as an open question); 'Customs document code' with value C085; 'Inspection status' with value 'Not required' (derived from the always-low stubbed risk assessment — the only reachable pass-1 outcome).
No Copy-to-clipboard buttons and no client JS anywhere on the page (decision: the bespoke IPAFFS copy-button widget is not carried over); all reference values are selectable text.

The legacy banner+panel composite is NOT reproduced: no recoloured title-less panel, no header-only notification banner, no inline style overrides — inspection status is a summary-list row per the page spec's govukAlternative.
govuk-warning-text renders 'You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.'

Guidance sections render as h2 + govuk-body: 'What you need to do' (haulier no-inspection line + govuk-inset-text 'Initial risk assessments can change.'), 'What happens next', and 'How to view or amend this notification'.

Two exits render as real govuk components (never the legacy link-button class): 'Return to your dashboard' linking to the plant dashboard path '/plant-products' (dashboardPath() resolves the set mount per request — a bare '/' here would be the server-wide 302 to /live-animals, i.e. the wrong set), and 'Create a new notification' matching the dashboard feature's create control.
The page is terminal: no back link, no continue/save buttons, no form inputs, and zero validation messages (the page has no POST route).
Deep-linking the confirmation slug on a notification whose status is not SUBMITTED redirects to that notification's hub.
English and Welsh copy bundles are structure-identical; copy-convention and copy-parity suites stay green; no user-facing string lives outside the copy bundles.
The declaration page's successful submit (pp-039) lands on this page.
Axe scan of the rendered page (wcag2a + wcag2aa tags) reports zero serious or critical violations, and the spec independently asserts exactly one h1.

notes: Closes the manual own-org happy path (import-type -> ... -> declaration -> confirmation). Exemplar transposed file-for-file: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/{page.js,controller.js,template.njk,copy/,controller.test.js,confirmation.e2e.spec.js} — GET-only controller with a SUBMITTED-status hub-redirect guard, routes-only registration (no meta, NOT in dispatchPages — verified live: live-animals features/index.js lists declaration.meta but not confirmation, while flow.js:85 places confirmationPage in the review section), govukPanel titleText as the H1. Rulings applied from the confirmation page spec: (1) render a proper govuk-panel with govuk-panel__title h1 per the GOV.UK confirmation-page pattern — the headline c-014-family fix (IPAFFS ships this page with NO h1); (2) inspection status becomes a summary-list row, not the bespoke recoloured banner+panel composite (spec govukAlternative); (3) Copy-to-clipboard widget omitted (bespoke, JS-only, untested in IPAFFS, identical 'Copy' accessible names, duplicate-id defect; spec recommends omission — values remain selectable text, GDS no-JS baseline holds); (4) legacy Qualtrics footer_feedback block, link-button class, and stale CVED/CHED-P ids (raise-another-cvedp etc.) NOT carried over; (5) legacy-confirmed BINARY outcome for CHED-PP (chedpp/confirmation.js branches only on isInspectionRequired) — with pass-1 risk stubbed always-low, only the not-required variant is buildable, and per the MAPPING brief the inspection-required / Check-GVMS / place-of-destination variants are post-submission-risk territory and out of scope; the not-required variant's copy set (haulier line + inset) is taken verbatim from the served legacy template family (confirmationGvmsNoInspection.html), not the unused partials family. 'What happens next' ifChanges line is rewritten service-neutral (drops the 'IPAFFS will notify you' branding). C085 is a module constant in the controller, not copy (same in both locales, it is a code not text). No obligations, no bindings, no evaluation.js, no check-answers rows, no mapper change, no webpack entry (no client JS), no contract-table case (no collecting POST) — this is the thinnest page shape in the set. Sibling-safety: no L2/platform files touched, so the heavier co-residency ladder legs (test:live-animals, test:features:all) are not mandated; npm test still exercises the shared app-root suites including co-residency.test.js, which must stay green. The bar is BOTH sets serving correctly from ONE process under their own symmetric mounts (live-animals at /live-animals, plant-products at /plant-products, / a server-wide 302 to /live-animals) — not a one-sided 'live-animals is unaffected' check.
openQuestions: Customs-declaration reference scheme for GBN-PP refs: IPAFFS derives 'GBCHD2026.NNNNNNN' from 'CHEDPP.GB.2026.NNNNNNN', but SCHEMA-DESIGN D-5 rejected that reference format, so no derivation exists for GBN-PP-YY-XXXXXX. Pass 1 renders the notification reference itself in the customs row (decision, recorded in controller helper customsDeclarationReference()); confirm the real customs reference scheme when customs/Dynamics integration is scoped and swap the helper.

Confirm C085 remains the correct customs document code for this service's CHED-PP notifications (constant across both corpus traces; sourced from IPAFFS, not from our backend, which has no customsDocCode field — hence rendered as a frontend constant, not schemaField).

Page-spec CORRECTION 2 question carried forward: CHED-PP collects CTC + GVMS (pp-031) and shares the IPAFFS template family with CHED-P, so 'Check GVMS' may be reachable for plants under a real risk engine even though the legacy CHED-PP handler is binary. Product to rule when post-submission risk variants are built; pass 1 is unaffected (stub risk always low).
